bio.text: John Mannion represents New York's 22nd Congressional District, covering Central New York and the Mohawk Valley, including Syracuse and Utica.

Before Congress he served as a New York State Senator and chaired the Senate Committee on Disabilities; earlier he spent nearly 30 years teaching high school science and was president of the West Genesee Teachers' Association for eight years.
A graduate of the SUNY system, having attended Binghamton University and SUNY Oswego, he was raised in Syracuse and lives in Geddes.
